name: Compliance Deep-Dive
summary: Tiresias — the compliance detective, two lenses over the same data. By Asset: point it at one asset for every audit check it passed/failed/warned (actual vs expected, framework mappings) plus the inferred link between a failed control and the real vulns backing it, which you can tag. By Audit File: the same estate through the benchmark — an audit-file leaderboard, per-file adherence, the checks and assets each file covers, and the real vulns backing its failing controls, at aggregate and per file. Launched from Minos.
